variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.body: A scandal concerning {leader}, the leader of {party}, has come to light. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Leadership under an unwelcome spotlight
variants.body: The leader of {party}, {leader}, is the subject of a newly revealed scandal. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.body: A scandal about {leader}, leader of {party}, has become public. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
